title: Team-hosted (external meetings)
description: For a deployment in a team's own AWS account that records meetings with people from several external organizations, whose guests must not reach the team's other meetings or its knowledge. Consent comes first: Meeting Consent mode Opt-in with the each-participant rule, a meeting may only use this mode or a stricter one, so it cannot switch to the owner attesting for everyone, streaming clients without a consent step are refused, the Virtual Participant leaves after an objection, and evidence screenshots are kept. The consent request is posted in the meeting chat; it is not spoken. A participant who does not consent is not transcribed. Stream Audio/Video and the Desktop Capture App cannot collect each participant's consent, so Start is refused from them; the Webex join cannot tell who is present, so a Webex meeting is never granted. Meeting audio, screen video from streaming clients and Virtual Participant meeting video are not recorded. A request made in the meeting is turned off (In-meeting requests: who may ask, Off): a Virtual Participant knows a chat sender only by the display name the meeting shows, so it cannot tell the owner from a guest, and it does not start its voice assistant. In-meeting requests are also held to the current meeting only, with no access to the meeting context and checklist, should a profile copied from this one allow requests again. Web search and the installed MCP servers are offered to no request, the meeting page's chat included. Live guidance is on for new meetings: the people running a meeting are offered guidance in its Notifications drawer, never in the meeting chat and never to guests. New meetings are summarized with the discovery-session summary profile. The transcript is kept, and the meeting chat added to it; personal information is not redacted and Amazon Bedrock models run as chosen (Global inference geography). Every other setting stays as it is. Some controls are stack parameters rather than settings, and have to be set when the stack is deployed or updated: EnableVideoRecording false, so no meeting video and no key frames are kept; TranscriptionExpirationInDays and MeetingRecordExpirationInDays (90 days by default) for how long transcripts and meeting records are kept; and AllowedSignUpEmailDomain left empty, so an Admin creates every user. See docs/hosting-models.md.

values.videoNoticeText: Video of the meeting, including shared screens and any visible camera feeds, is also recorded.
